results.title: Fox News halted as Trump talks defying Melania with 'gay National Anthem'
results.description: Fox News cut away from Laura Ingraham's panel to air Trump joking that Melania dislikes his dance moves.

results.title: TikTok agrees to pay $400 million to the government to settle child privacy lawsuit
results.description: TikTok has now settled a lawsuit, originally launched by the Biden administration, that accused it of letting kids under 13 sign up without parental supervision.
